faqs.a:
Section 302.3.1. Parking lots,
is hereby added to read as follows:
"
302.3.1. Parking lots.
All cracks, potholes, or other breaks in the surface of a parking lot shall be filled
                  in and repaired promptly by the proprietor, who shall also take all other steps to
                  ensure that the parking lot is reasonably available for use by the public."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
